P02-SYS-MOVE-SEMANTICS.reason: P02 establishes names and the optional main-series identity crosswalk only. P14 still requires the original PMD numerical, targeting, learning and effect corpus.

P02-SYS-ACTION-SEMANTICS.reason: P13 must specify the regular attack action against the unresolved complete Blue scheduler and exact damage arithmetic.

P02-SYS-ACTION-CLASSIFICATION.reason: The original-edition source includes move, orb and internal-action records. This named row has no accepted obtainable/internal/orb classification or executable behavior contract.

P02-SYS-ABILITY-SEMANTICS.reason: Identity alone does not establish original Blue holders, triggers, interaction ordering or effects; P14 owns these fields.

P02-SYS-CACOPHONY.reason: DATA identifies Cacophony as an unresolved unused/internal crosswalk question. It is not promoted to a usable original Blue ability and is absent from the 76-name original list.

P02-SYS-ITEM-CORPUS.reason: These are planning coverage groups, not the full item-index corpus. Original item identities, availability and behavior remain to be extracted and reviewed for P15/P20.

P02-SYS-STATUS-SEMANTICS.reason: Only status identity is normalized. P15 must validate original Blue timers, overwrites, cures and floor-reset behavior without transferring later-edition rules.

P02-SYS-CONDITION-SEMANTICS.reason: These source-named indicators are not automatically ordinary status conditions. P15/P16 must define their state and UI boundaries.

P02-SYS-TRAP-SEMANTICS.reason: P15 must verify trap triggers, owners, persistence, effects and exact source-index mapping; no probability, damage or spawn defaults are supplied.

P02-SYS-TRIP-AVAILABILITY.reason: DATA tentatively includes Trip Trap, but the retrieved G16 RB column marks it unavailable with a footnote while listing index 05. Its ordinary Blue availability remains blocked.

P02-SYS-WEATHER-SEMANTICS.reason: The eight identity names do not freeze original Blue weather priority, counters, effects or per-floor conditions; P15 owns those contracts.

P02-SYS-IQ-SEMANTICS.reason: The original 23-name set is established, but P17 still needs reviewed complete skill groups, thresholds, behavior and Gummi relationships.

P02-SYS-AREA-SEMANTICS.reason: A Friend Area identity does not establish prices, acquisition predicates, capacity, full species mapping or explorable resident interactions; P17 owns these fields.

P02-SYS-AREA-COUNT.reason: The original-only list supplies 57 named areas; historical research/systems.json says 58 without an enumerated 58th identity. Reconcile the total with edition-specific evidence before claiming complete coverage.
